hypotheses.persona: A single working adult who commutes to work on weekdays, returns in the evening for a meal, and engages in evening DIY/hobby projects. On weekends, they stay home, relax, and have later meals.
hypotheses.rationale: Consistent weekday morning departure (keys, laptop_bag, phone at 08:11) and evening meal (plate at table_d1 around 18:00). Weekend shows no morning departure, phone at nightstand in the afternoon (nap/relax), and later meals. Sunday also shows radio at workbench at 10:11, indicating continued hobby/DIY activity. Day 9 confirms weekday pattern: laptop_bag at entry_hook at 17:37 (return from work), paint_roller at paint_shelf at 18:56 (evening DIY), phone at workbench at 18:56 (evening hobby). Day 10 adds radio at counter at 06:52 (morning routine) and paint_roller at paint_shelf at 19:33 (evening DIY), consistent with weekday pattern.

hypotheses.persona: A person who works from home or has a flexible schedule, with occasional evening DIY projects.
hypotheses.rationale: The strong weekday departure of keys at 08:11 makes this less likely. The weekend pattern could also fit a work-from-home person, but the consistent morning departure on weekdays is more indicative of a commute. This hypothesis is retained with low probability in case future evidence (e.g., a weekday where keys stay home) emerges.
